result.title: WorldUAV: Scaling UAV Data Synthesis via World Models
result.summary: UAV detection and tracking remain constrained by the scarcity of high-quality training data. Existing game-engine-based synthetic UAV data suffer from a substantial synthetic-to-real gap, while the high cost of manually collected real-world UAV data limits dataset scale. Therefore, we introduce WorldUAV, a high-quality UAV dataset constructed through an efficient framework powered by world models. Specifically, WorldUAV directly integrates UAVs into readily available real-world videos, naturally preserving realistic backgrounds, illumination, and scene dynamics. Leveraging the spatiotemporal priors of world models, it generates UAV videos with plausible motion, pose variations, and cross-frame consistency, effectively narrowing the gap between synthetic and real data. We further develop an agentic pipeline orchestrated by a multimodal large language model that acquires sources, plans UAV trajectories, invokes synthesis, and verifies generated videos, enabling fully automated dataset construction. WorldUAV comprises 6,878 UAV videos and 205,778 UAV images. Experiments show that WorldUAV significantly improves the performance of UAV detectors. Moreover, it substantially reduces dataset construction costs, requiring only 15 seconds and USD 0.0005 API cost per high-quality UAV image. Our work offers both a high-quality dataset and a scalable data generation paradigm for UAV detection and tracking.

AI.brief_summary: 该工作用 world model 将 UAV 合成进真实视频，构建 6,878 段视频与约 20 万张图像的数据集，并以 MLLM 代理自动化采集、轨迹规划与质量校验，用于提升 UAV 检测性能。
AI.relevance_reason: 这属于面向检测任务的合成数据生成与 UAV 应用，world model 仅作视频生成器，未涉及视觉推理中的 latent 状态、证据筛选或停止决策，缺乏可迁移的具体线索。
